angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 295,673 km at 98.84 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.1177 +/- 0.0231 mas (same row, RUWE 1.03): 98.84 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.425 +/- 0.0091 solar radii from Hartman et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-762 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract): 295,673 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.442 +/- 0.025 solar masses from Hartman et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-762 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3266 +/- 36 K from Hartman et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-762 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hartman et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-762 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-762-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.827, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-762: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-762 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.357 dex, from Hartman et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-762 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.73283, from Hartman et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-762 A (pscomppars): age 9.3 Gyr, from Hartman et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..202H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
